scope: All 10 historical PRs; complete review-thread pagination. Resolution is not inferred from merge state.

findings.finding: **🟡 Medium · Sensitive files are staged** When a contributor adds transcripts, performance notes, or model weights outside `/private/` in an otherwise unignored format, `.gitignore` does not exclude those files, so `git add -A` stages them and a push exposes their contents despite the stated default boundary.

**🟡 Medium · Broken heading links pass** When a Markdown link points to a missing heading in an existing file or to a missing same-page heading, `main()` checks only whether the target file exists and skips same-page fragments, so links to missing headings pass the advertised documentation-link check.
**🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win** **Run the source-cut check for camera cues even when `field_gain` is 0.**
**🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win**
